title: lepidium persicum var. spathulatum
intro: Lepidium persicum var. spathulatum, commonly known as Persian cress or garden cress, is a variant of the species Lepidium persicum, a flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lepidium persicum var. spathulatum include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
